card.name: Linking spots before a condition or number
card.fires_on: Small connecting marks just before a medical condition or figure: 'with' after 'patients', a colon, a space before a number, or 'a'/'an' before a disease name.

modes.label: 'with' after patients
modes.description: The word 'with' following 'patients' where a disease or condition comes next.
modes.example: Caution should be exercised when prescribing modafinil tablets to patients<< with>> known cardiovascular disease.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or digit inside a price, year or percentage just before the figure.

modes.label: Punctuation before a list
modes.description: A colon or comma that leads into names or further conditions.
modes.example: two drugmakers won most of PEPFAR's contracts<<:>> Aurobindo, an Indian firm

card.writes: It seems to steer away from the word 'conditions' and favor names or other odd continuations.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words and marks right before a named condition, name or number.
